details: This package is an unofficial fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library that carries two non-upstream behaviours affecting the installing machine and the linked WhatsApp account. On first socket use, lib/Socket/socket.js resolves the machine's public IP address through hxxps://api[.]ipify[.]org, hxxps://api4[.]ipify[.]org, hxxps://ipinfo[.]io and hxxps://checkip[.]amazonaws[.]com and compares it with a hardcoded allowlist of 20[.]207[.]192[.]84 and 173[.]212[.]202[.]60; when the address is not on that list it prints "Unauthorized IP" and calls process.exit(1), terminating the host application. lib/Socket/newsletter.js contains the constant AUTO_FOLLOW_NEWSLETTER = "120363410154606795@newsletter" and, on every connection open, queries the account's subscription state and issues a FOLLOW request, subscribing the user's WhatsApp account to that channel without asking. The manifest also lists the package itself as a dependency (@ubedsockets/baileys ^1.7.9). lib/Voip/worker-bootstrap.js runs eval() over the contents of files passed to a re-implemented importScripts; its only caller resolves that path to the bundled lib/Voip/worker-bootstrap.js. The shipped code contains no credential, token or file exfiltration.
